goals.statement: Automate lead follow-up across channels to reduce manual work and convert more cold or quote-stage leads.
Integrate website and Podium lead data with Cin7/Sin7 so leads move without manual re-entry.
Use AI to answer customer product questions after hours and eventually as a fallback during business hours.

whats_working.summary: Reviews is actively engaged in the last 30 days.
Messaging is actively engaged in the last 30 days.
Payments is actively engaged in the last 30 days.
Campaigns is actively engaged in the last 30 days.

gaps.summary: Webchat produced 8 leads in the last 30 days, below the underuse threshold of 10, so the website is not yet contributing much to the lead flow they want to automate. That matters because Auscraft said, "We got many leads coming from everywhere, not like on the internet on calls, Facebook, Instagram, shop visits, et cetera," and they are still doing "everyday manual labor" on lead creation while waiting on website and Cin7/Sin7 integration.
gaps.recommended_action: In the QBR, walk through where Webchat sits on the new website and ask Auscraft to identify the pages where quote-stage shoppers make decisions; align on one placement or routing change that should raise lead capture before discussing Cin7/Sin7 handoff.

opportunities.rationale: Auscraft wants Podium to reduce the weekly manual follow-up burden: "So, which is going to help me a lot like I do manually every week." Text AI fits that motion because they are already asking, "how we can now make the AI work?" and said "podium AI answers was like really good this week." It gives the AM a clear path to connect cold-lead follow-up with the AI setup work they already expect to finish.
opportunities.recommended_action: Propose a 30-day Text AI pilot for after-hours and cold/quote-stage lead follow-up, using Auscraft’s prepared product Q&A as the starting content.

opportunities.rationale: Auscraft’s AI goal is specifically about answering product questions after hours first: "Leave it AI response for after hours now, yep." Phones AI is a natural extension when those questions arrive by call rather than message, especially since they asked, "Can, can we train the AI to give you some information we want to give to customer yep?" Position it as the voice-side fallback once the written AI answers are approved.
opportunities.recommended_action: Add Phones AI as a second-step option in the QBR: after Text AI is live, map the top after-hours call questions Auscraft wants AI to answer.

opportunities.rationale: Auscraft described leads coming from "calls, Facebook, Instagram, shop visits, et cetera," and wants less manual follow-up across those channels. Paid Phones gives the AM a way to bring call-sourced leads into the same Podium-led follow-up conversation instead of leaving calls as a separate manual workflow. This supports the outcome they already see value in: "At least I can tell five, six customer podium converted from cold leads."
opportunities.recommended_action: Pitch Paid Phones as the call-channel foundation for lead capture and follow-up, tied to their existing goal of converting more cold and quote-stage leads through Podium.
